label: Leather
description: Wearing leather clothes, touching leather, or feeling it against our skin during play.

label: Latex & rubber
description: Wearing stretchy rubber or latex clothing, touching it, or feeling it against each other during play.

label: Vinyl & PVC
description: Wearing or touching clothes and materials made from shiny, smooth vinyl or PVC together.

label: Silk & satin
description: Wearing smooth silk or satin clothes, touching the fabric, or moving it over each other’s skin.

label: Lace
description: Wearing lace clothes, touching the patterned fabric, or feeling it against each other’s skin.

label: Denim
description: Wearing denim clothes, touching the fabric, or rubbing against it during play together.

label: Uniforms
description: Wearing uniforms together or including one person’s uniform in our play, without necessarily acting out the job.

label: Lingerie
description: Wearing lingerie, showing it to each other, or touching it while one of us wears it.

label: Underwear
description: Wearing underwear during play, showing it to each other, or touching the garments.

label: Stockings
description: Wearing stockings or tights, helping put them on, or touching them against each other’s legs.

label: Gloves
description: Wearing gloves or touching each other with gloved hands during play.

label: Boots
description: Wearing boots during play, showing them to each other, or touching the boots themselves.

label: Shoes & heels
description: Wearing shoes or heels during play, showing them to each other, or touching the footwear.

label: Masks
description: Wearing masks together or having one person wear a mask while we play.

label: Hoods
description: Wearing head-covering hoods together or having one person wear a hood while we play.

label: Collars
description: Wearing collars, putting them on each other, or touching them during play.

label: Harnesses
description: Wearing body harnesses or helping each other put on and adjust the straps.

label: Corsets
description: Wearing corsets, helping put them on, or touching the structured fabric around each other’s torso.

label: Full-body suits
description: Wearing suits that cover most of the body, or touching each other through the covering.

label: Wet clothing
description: Wearing soaked clothes together or touching each other through the wet fabric.

label: Sportswear
description: Wearing athletic clothing together or including it in play through looking at or touching it.

label: Formalwear
description: Wearing dress clothes during play, such as suits, dresses, or formal shirts, or helping each other dress.

label: Spandex
description: Wearing stretchy spandex or Lycra clothing together or touching each other through the close-fitting fabric.

label: Nylon & hosiery fabric
description: Wearing nylon garments, such as hosiery, or touching the thin, smooth fabric against each other’s skin.

label: Neoprene
description: Wearing neoprene together or touching each other through the thick, springy material used in wetsuits.

label: Fur-like textures
description: Wearing fur-like materials or stroking the soft surface against each other’s skin.

label: Socks
description: Wearing socks together, showing them to each other, or touching the socks during play.

label: Metal & chains
description: Wearing metal or chain accessories together, touching them, or hearing them move during play.

label: Balloons & inflatables
description: Touching, holding, or moving balloons and inflatable objects, including the sounds or feelings they produce.

label: Plush toys
description: Holding, stroking, or including stuffed toys as props during play.

label: Dolls & mannequins
description: Looking at, handling, or positioning dolls or mannequins during play, rather than having a partner act as one.
